detections.evidence_quote: Today, American's overall health is in grievous condition.
detections.summary: Plays RFK Jr.'s Senate confirmation-hearing opening statement laying out the MAHA movement's account of rising chronic disease in America.

detections.evidence_quote: Autoimmune diseases, neurodevelopmental disorders, Alzheimer's, asthma, ADHD, depression, addiction, and a host of other physical and mental health conditions are all on the rise
detections.summary: RFK Jr. frames a broad rise in chronic childhood and adult disease as the crisis the administration will address.

detections.evidence_quote: Over seventy percent of adults and a third of children are overweight or obese.
detections.summary: Cites obesity/overweight prevalence in adults and children as evidence of a health crisis.

detections.evidence_quote: Cancer among young people is rising by one or two percent a year.
detections.summary: Cites a rising rate of cancer among young people.

detections.evidence_quote: Autoimmune diseases, neurodevelopmental disorders, Alzheimer's, asthma, ADHD, depression, addiction, and a host of other physical and mental health conditions are all on the rise
detections.summary: Lists autoimmune disease, neurodevelopmental disorders, Alzheimer's, asthma, ADHD, depression, and addiction as rising chronic conditions without discussing any individually.

detections.evidence_quote: I am pro safety, pro vaccine.
detections.summary: RFK Jr. rebuts characterizations of him as anti-vaccine or anti-industry, stating he is pro-safety and pro-vaccine.

detections.evidence_quote: Let's get then to what he referenced their vaccine statements.
detections.summary: Host previews that Senate Democrats' criticism of RFK Jr. centered on his past vaccine statements.
